insights.one_liner: Johnson & Johnson MedTech makes surgical tools, devices and implants; an IND recognised sponsor with English-language entry roles in Breda and Leiden.

culture.text: The medical-technology arm of Johnson & Johnson, with about 38,148 employees, working in surgery, orthopaedics, cardiovascular and vision.
Staff often have business, mechanical or biomedical engineering backgrounds and work in sales, operations, engineering and research.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (Johnson & Johnson Medical BV).

growth.text: MedTech sales grew 4.5% in the second quarter and the company raised its guidance.
Received US FDA authorization for its OTTAVA robotic surgical system.

worth_knowing.text: Its Abiomed unit recalled Automated Impella Controllers after 3 patient deaths.
Parent Johnson & Johnson agreed to pay $5.5 billion to resolve talc litigation.
